correctness.rationale: Direct basis evaluation of weight-zero binary and ternary Rota–Baxter identities for R=[[a,b],[c,d]] gives a²+bc=0, c(a+d)=0, a²(a+d)=0 with no characteristic-specific division. Case a=0 gives either the plane a=c=0 or the square-zero matrices with a=b=d=0 and c≠0. Case a≠0 forces d=−a,bc=−a². Hence precisely plane A={a=c=0} ∪ square-zero cone N={trR=detR=0}; their overlap is line a=c=d=0. For any finite field F_q each component has q² points, intersection q, total 2q²−q and rank profile (1,2q²−q−1,0). The algebra automorphism matrices [[s,t],[0,1]] (s≠0) act by conjugation; orbits have sizes 1, q−1, q repeated q−1 times, q(q−1), total q+2. Counting over extensions gives zeta (1−qT)/(1−q²T)². No assumption of algebraically closed or characteristic-zero field is used.
